shortBulletSummary: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) recorded $871 million in inflows last week, signaling robust institutional demand.
US-Iran tensions persist, with Iran reportedly demanding cryptocurrency tolls for ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
The US Senate crypto bill faces an April setback, delaying efforts for regulatory clarity in the digital asset space.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index registered "Fear" on April 20, despite Bitcoin maintaining a relatively stable price.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is approaching, with interest rates widely expected to remain at 3.50-3.75%.
